claim_boundary: claim_class=preliminary_controlled_testbed on one Windows/WSL2 physical node, one RTX 4080, one Triton GPU container, four named seeded CUDA test models using governed HIGGS/Criteo inputs, and direct local load. model_derivation_claim=false, prepared_model_equivalence_claim=false, model_accuracy_claim=false, and dlrm_training_quality_claim=false. L1W1/L2W4 denote client admission lanes and load-driver workers, not deployed API replicas or service CPU workers. It is non-credit and is not canonical X1, production capacity, an SLA, HA/DR, tenant isolation, multi-node, multi-GPU, MPS, MIG, or kernel-overlap evidence unless a profiler directly proves overlap.

off.profiler_scope: disabled for bounded timed-matrix evidence; request intervals and metric deltas captured

on.profiler_scope: disabled for bounded timed-matrix evidence; request intervals and metric deltas captured

q0_isolated.profiler_scope: isolated Q0 Triton request timestamps only

profiler.claim: No kernel-overlap claim; a direct CUDA profiler is a follow-up gate.
